coverage.reason: The initial draft already keeps both measured pronoun families within range and uses them for concrete reader consequences and collective stakes.
The initial draft already keeps conversational contractions and uncontracted negatives within their paired measured ranges.
The initial draft concedes that age rules and privacy constraints may be useful before narrowing and rebutting the claims made for them.
The initial draft already uses questions to expose the mechanism and remains within the measured question-mark range.
The initial draft places opposing terms in quotation marks and corrects them through concrete consequences without inventing sources or attributed wording.
The initial draft already places one compressed vulgar judgment at an argumentative payoff, within the measured range.
The initial draft already uses first-person singular as analytical witness without inventing biography and remains within the measured range.
Parenthetical spans, zero em dashes, and en dashes all already fall within their paired measured ranges and serve the specified interruptive functions.
The initial draft extends gate, machine, key, building, passport, and plumbing analogies into practical and political consequences.
The initial draft opens with a blunt proposition and closes by recombining safety, system naming, and power into a compact warning.
